anomalies.description: A white car collides with a person on a motorcycle or scooter in the middle of a wet road at night; the person is thrown to the ground and the vehicle continues forward slightly before stopping.

A yellow taxi (Gett) collides with the right side of a black sedan while attempting to overtake or cut in front, causing visible deformation of the taxi's front-right fender and wheel well. The black car is stationary or moving slowly ahead.

A light-colored sedan (possibly beige or silver) is seen skidding sideways across a muddy, unpaved area, emitting a plume of dark smoke or dust from its rear tires, indicating loss of control and possible collision with unseen obstacle or ground irregularity.

A white sedan is seen skidding sideways across a muddy, unpaved area, emitting smoke from its tires, indicating a loss of control and likely a collision or near-collision with a stationary object or another vehicle (a white SUV is parked nearby). The car’s orientation changes significantly over the frames, consistent with a crash or severe slide.

The same sedan comes to rest at an angle, partially obstructing the path; smoke/dust continues to rise, and a person briefly appears near the driver’s side door around 45.0s, suggesting aftermath of impact and possible occupant egress or assessment.
A white sedan rapidly veers left and collides with a small structure or barrier near the center of the frame, producing a visible dust/smoke plume upon impact.
